# Draft:Connecting Software

Connecting Software is a software company founded in 2004 that produces integration, synchronization, and productivity solutions for various business processes. The company’s focus is on simplifying software integration by applying pre-built connectors that translate one programming interface to another . It also sells Truth Enforcer, a software solution designed to verify the integrity of digital files.
It is headquartered in Vienna, but also has offices in the United States, Slovakia and Portugal.
